dimensions.mission: A tail and B intake of one managed Jupiter account share one durable day/credit/cumulative allocation; a new activation cannot reset it. Live enablement stays behind a separate OPERATE gate.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Existing per-activation counters stay the only debit history; membership and append-only policy revisions are external runtime rows, so frozen schedules, grants and envelopes keep their hashes. Pre-bridge stores read as UNMANAGED; the bridge is default-off.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One task, one checkout, one new small module plus seams in the existing owners; 19 focused tests, 25-module/424-test direct-consumer regression and one reused preflight geometry probe. No pre-PR full gate; exact-head CI is mandatory.
dimensions.research_truth: No estimand, denominator, PIT or field semantics change. Under shared exhaustion slots get the existing typed SLOT_NOT_EXECUTED:BLOCKED_BUDGET gap (unknown, never negative evidence); DRAINING tails are served before ACTIVE intake.
dimensions.owner_operability: Four CLI subcommands with typed terminals and next_action, runbook table, BLOCKED_BUDGET keeps its enum while budget_denial names ACTIVATION vs SHARED_ACCOUNT, one OPERATE packet with acceptance numbers and stop conditions, Russian owner readout.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: Collection operability only; no trading, alpha, revenue, wallet or cashflow claim; no provider call or tariff claim.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: account-budget-status and operability account_envelope expose usage/remaining/membership; the same SQLite carries bindings through the existing mutable backup; restore marker blocks commissioning; downgrade after managed debits is named forbidden.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: ADOPT existing store, writer lease, _Accounting, CLI and release path. WRAP them with membership aggregation. No package, service, queue, distributed limiter or second ledger.
dimensions.security: Only the credential slot name is bound; the key value is never read or hashed. No secrets, no external writes, no production mutation in this atom.
dimensions.red_team: Activation-only lookup and hash-ordered tick are mutation-killed by the controls; stale snapshot, concurrent last call, crash between day/lifetime writes, membership loss and scope replacement fail closed.

capability_radar.now: Exact merge gate, then one OPERATE: deploy merge artifact, live UNMANAGED readback, prepare/apply JUPITER-MANAGED-ACCOUNT-1 without reset, ordinary-tick readback. No new tool.
capability_radar.watch: I2 footprint/compression; a sustainable successor window (half-day B is SHORT_BRIDGE_ONLY); producer V2 hashes before the first fresh C3+ capture; A intake stop 2026-10-17T00:00Z.

recovery: Before commissioning, ordinary code rollback to 4378c5b8. After managed debits, forward fix only; policy rollback is a new revision; never restore an older SQLite or edit counters.
